fields.summary_ko.0: GOOGL is scheduled to report Q3 2026 results on October 28, with analysts expecting average revenue of $127.8 billion (up 25% year-over-year) and EPS of $3.00.
fields.summary_ko.1: Despite beating earnings over the past four quarters, GOOGL showed irregular post-announcement moves: up twice and down twice in the last four quarters, with 7 up days and 9 down days over the past four years (16 quarters).
fields.summary_ko.2: In Q2, adjusted EPS of $2.85 missed consensus by $0.04, capital expenditure is expected to increase significantly in 2027, and the company recorded negative free cash flow for the first time in history.
